limitations: One of 60 optimized samples still exceeds 33 ms, including after source-geometry reuse.
CPU submission timings are not presented FPS, GPU duration or end-to-end input latency.
First preview still rebuilds stationary artwork and prepares original-board snapping geometry.
Placement, layer/via changes, Finish and History keep full board validation and may stall.
Large polygon distance calculations, long routes, other boards/hardware, retained external snapshots, repour and globally changed display states remain incomplete performance coverage.
Linux runtime, new AppImage and exact Altium functional/visual parity are unverified.
